title: "cellsnp"

namespace: "Genetic demux"
description: "cellSNP aims to pileup the expressed alleles in single-cell or bulk RNA-seq data. It can be directly used for donor deconvolution in multiplexed single-cell RNA-seq data, particularly with vireo."
type: "module"
latest: "true"

`--sam_file`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Indexed sam/bam file(s), comma separated multiple samples. Mode 1a & 2a: one sam/bam file with single cell. Mode 1b & 2b: one or multiple bulk sam/bam files, no barcodes needed, but sample ids and regionsVCF.

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/genetic_demux/cellsnp/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/genetic_demux/cellsnp);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/genetic_demux/cellsnp/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
